svg.title: Fantasy Cards Generator implemented architecture
svg.desc: Generated exclusively from architecture.drawio. Source SHA256: 35f7e503e93ff635a981ee573531f9f5a47107458045a44e353e96e20e27cd68. Solid lines show calls or dependencies; dashed purple lines show opt-in hosted orchestration; dashed grey lines show identity, delivery and telemetry.

text.tspan: MICROSOFT FOUNDRY | AI Services account + project
AZURE / PRIVATE SERVICES | public network access disabled
Repository topology, not a live Azure inventory | direct models by default; hosted text orchestration is opt-in
Solid: runtime / data access Purple dashed: opt-in agent Grey dashed: identity, delivery or telemetry Arrows show calls/dependencies; responses omitted.
Generation safety and persistence stay in FastAPI. Retryable agent errors / routing_defer can fall back once to direct text; auth, policy and schema failures do not.
